Early on in the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Republic agents aboard the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Kilran's Lance]] above [[Aeten II/Legends|Aeten II]] disabled the station's defenses and a Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] '''attacked''' the station. However, the [[Empire's Fury]] squadron arrived in time to drive off the attackers and secure the station.

==Behind the scenes==
In some parts of the game's text files, Aeten II is mistakenly referred to as Aeten Ten, but mission log text relating to the Aeten Defense mission correctly names it as Aeten Two.
